summary: Gilze Rijen Air Base is a Royal Netherlands Air Force facility located in the province of North Brabant, between the cities of Breda and Tilburg. It serves as one of the principal operational bases for Dutch fighter aircraft and helicopter squadrons, and has a long aviation history dating back to before World War II. While primarily military, it also accommodates a small civilian flying club on the field.
faqs:
Q: Is Gilze Rijen a commercial passenger airport?
A: No, it is an active military airbase operated by the Royal Netherlands Air Force and does not handle scheduled commercial flights.

Q: Can civilians visit the base?
A: Access is generally restricted, but the base occasionally hosts public open days featuring aircraft displays and demonstrations.
